source_audit.source_name: Heritage at Risk in Northern Ireland records
source_audit.publisher: Department for Communities Historic Environment Division / nidirect
source_audit.license_or_terms_note: Crown copyright / Open Government Licence for public-sector information unless otherwise stated; nidirect states logos, images, third-party rights, and OSNI-derived mapping are excluded. Use factual metadata and source URLs only.
source_audit.geographic_scope: Northern Ireland heritage-at-risk records; this audit selected Belfast addresses only.
source_audit.granularity: Named heritage asset with HARNI number, HB reference where available, address, status, condition, occupancy, degree of risk, and narrative review notes.
source_audit.reliability: strong for official register/status fields; usable with caveats for status-review dates and narrative condition notes.
source_audit.required_caveats: HARNI records document heritage-risk status and review observations. They do not prove construction, repair completion, reuse, safety, occupation, or ownership change unless directly stated. Coordinates are approximate address points, not protected boundaries.
source_audit.ingestion_recommendation: Ingest as heritage-status or heritage-condition events, visually distinct from completed physical works and excluded from headline construction totals.

source_audit.source_name: DfI Belfast public transport, project, and procurement pages
source_audit.license_or_terms_note: Crown copyright / Open Government Licence for public-sector information unless otherwise stated; logos, images, and third-party rights excluded. Use factual metadata and source URLs only.
source_audit.geographic_scope: Northern Ireland public infrastructure records; this audit selected Belfast or Belfast-corridor records only.
source_audit.granularity: Project page, news item, or procurement table row with publication date, project name, stage/status, and sometimes route/works scope.
source_audit.reliability: strong for official publication and procurement milestones; usable with caveats for future programme stages.
source_audit.required_caveats: Project-stage announcements and awarded contracts are not evidence of construction start, completion, opening, patronage, journey-time effects, or regeneration outcomes. Multi-council corridors must be clipped or labelled for Belfast-only interpretation.
source_audit.ingestion_recommendation: Use for official project-stage, opening, and procurement milestones with plain stage labels.

source_audit.source_name: DfC historic environment and regeneration pages
source_audit.license_or_terms_note: Crown copyright / Open Government Licence for public-sector information unless otherwise stated; logos, images, and third-party rights excluded. Use factual metadata and source URLs only.
source_audit.geographic_scope: Northern Ireland historic environment, regeneration, and public-property records; this audit selected Belfast-specific records only.
source_audit.granularity: Publication/news page with date, named project/site, applicant or owner where stated, and stage/status text.
source_audit.reliability: strong for official funding, brief, or heritage-programme status; usable with caveats where records summarize earlier project history.
source_audit.required_caveats: Funding, development briefs, conservation-work status, and heritage-event participation are not proof of final permission, construction, completion, public opening, or long-term reuse unless stated.
source_audit.ingestion_recommendation: Use for DfC-held project-stage, funding/support, and heritage-status events after duplicate screening against council and project pages.

source_audit.source_name: Belfast City Council news, planning, and current application pages
source_audit.license_or_terms_note: Belfast City Council website content is council copyright with restricted redistribution terms. Store factual metadata and URLs only; do not reproduce images or extended text without permission.
source_audit.granularity: News page, planning application advertisement, committee update, or project page with publication/advertisement date and named site or project.
source_audit.reliability: strong for council publication, advertisement, and committee-stage records; current application pages are live and can change.
source_audit.required_caveats: Planning advertisements are not decisions. Committee news can combine multiple agenda items. Council pages are not evidence of construction start, completion, opening, or use unless stated.
source_audit.ingestion_recommendation: Use for Belfast planning, reuse, consultation, and public-guidance milestones; capture accessed_at and source-date fields because live pages may change.
